findings.status: resolved; independent read-only code-and-evidence review complete
findings.summary: Candidate alignment.json is a mandatory public deliverable but the inspected execution/review path did not parse or enforce it.
evidence: Both candidate task.md require one named JSON object with exact case/version, exact obligation IDs, explicit complete/incomplete, actual declarations, representation and actual dependencies.
Inspected execution.py answer path extracted only Lean files, then enforced Main.lean and immutable inputs; no candidate alignment object was extracted.
Inspected review.py checked reviewer-provided declaration names against the Lean audit, but did not bind those names or status to candidate alignment.json.
findings.consequence: A missing, malformed, wrong-version, incompletely covered or explicitly incomplete candidate alignment table could be ignored while a reviewer supplied passing stage mappings.
findings.requested_fix: Parse the named candidate JSON; enforce case/version and exact unique IDs plus item shape; bind declarations to actual audited file/name pairs and reviewer mappings; do not permit a reviewer to promote incomplete candidate items; reject invalid mandatory artifact before a whole-chapter pass.
findings.root_response: Acknowledged and implementing shared extraction, exact ID/case/version checks, audited declaration binding, and incomplete-status ceiling. Closure awaits read-only code and regression-evidence review.

closure.extraction: Exactly one top-level named JSON fence is extracted from exact response bytes; nested fences are skipped, unclosed/multiple blocks, duplicate JSON keys and non-JSON constants rejected.
closure.identity_and_coverage: Frozen contract hash/id/version validated; candidate case_id/version match and items cover every frozen obligation exactly once; completion status, nonempty representation, actual declaration shape and allowed dependency IDs validated.
closure.compiled_binding: Every candidate declaration maps to an allowed submitted file, or explicitly permitted frozen background file, and to the matching module/name in the actual candidate audit inventory.
closure.review_binding: Review re-extracts the alignment from the frozen original response, checks exact object/span/hash against the receipt, repeats audit mapping validation, rejects incomplete items marked pass and rejects reviewer mappings differing from the candidate mappings.
closure.all_stage_gate: Any stage pass requiring alignment triggers receipt validation; whole-group pass still requires every mandatory stage pass. Partial/incomplete outcomes remain possible without inventing completion.
closure.route_freedom: No required author naming, proof order or one-to-one mapping. Actual candidate many-to-many mapping and arbitrary obligation order remain permitted.
closure.chapter_public_contract: Both chapter contracts require alignment; task additions disclose exact accepted fields and incomplete ceiling. CH03-D07 public obligations now explicitly disclose its pre-existing frozen-background reuse permission.
closure.validation_origin: Exact results transcribed from exec_command tool output; not a candidate model run.

validation_results.isolation: macOS sandbox-exec; approved outer execution so nested compiler isolation could start
